approach: Add athena-core/src/reconcile.rs with a pure `reconcile(git, main_tip, records, host)` over two small traits (`ReconcileRecords`, `CommitHost`) so tests need no network. Bound the walk on main's first-parent line after the earliest anchor (see decision 2). Per commit without a landing: match an intent on head tree + expected base (write from intent alone, no host call); else ask the host which merged PR made it; write only if an intent for that PR with the same head exists; otherwise report 'unattributed' and write nothing. `Athena::reconcile(runner, host_factory, ui)` never fails the command. Land calls it first in `Athena::land_pr`. Status goes through a new core function `Athena::status_with_reconcile(runner, ui)` that main.rs only calls, so the real status path is testable in core; a CLI integration test also runs `athena status`.

decisions.choice: Lower bound = the earlier of (a) the latest landing host_commit on main and (b) the earliest unfulfilled intent's expected_base on main, but never earlier than the first intent's expected_base. If no records branch, no intent, or the first intent's base is not on main's first-parent line, skip with a stated reason.
decisions.reason: Answers finding 3: an earlier crashed landing (A) is not silently passed over when a later landing (B) was written, because A's intent is still unfulfilled and its base is earlier. The first-intent floor still keeps pre-cutover commits out (AC5). Add a test recording this: A crashed, B landed, A is repaired.

decisions.choice: Host fallback writes a landing only when the host's merged PR number matches an existing intent with the same PR number and head_sha; else unattributed with reason.
decisions.reason: Landing.intent is required; inventing one is a guess.

decisions.choice: CommitHost::merged_pr(commit) -> Result<Option<MergedPr>> implemented on GhClient via GET repos/{r}/commits/{sha}/pulls, keeping merged_at set and merge_commit_sha == commit; zero => None, several => error 'ambiguous'. Logged as HostOperation::ReadPr; pure parse_merged_pr unit-tested.
decisions.reason: Reuses retry and logging; no change to non-deliverable records.rs.

decisions.choice: Merge method inferred from the commit: two parents => Merge, one => Squash.
decisions.reason: Host may be down; local path asks nothing of the host.

decisions.choice: Resolve main's branch locally first: `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD`; only if that fails, fall back to GhClient::default_branch (host). Then fetch origin/<branch>. Any failure becomes skipped, never an error.
decisions.reason: Answers finding 2: the pure-local repair path makes no host call in production. The fallback host call happens only when origin/HEAD is unset, and is stated as outside the repair itself.

rejected.option: Always ask the host for default branch
rejected.why: Host call on every land/status even when repair is local.

decisions.reason: Answers finding 1: the real status assembly is in core and testable with a fake Runner; the CLI test checks main.rs actually calls it. Existing Athena::status() stays unchanged (reconcile None).

risks.risk: Reconcile makes land/status fail or hang when network or origin is missing.
risks.mitigation: Every error becomes skipped or WriteFailed in the report; exit codes do not depend on it; test a missing origin.

risks.risk: Many host calls over a long unattributed range.
risks.mitigation: Bounded walk; one host call per unmatched commit; call count asserted.

risks.risk: Concurrent runs write the same landing twice.
risks.mitigation: GitLandingRecords::landing dedups by intent and host_commit landings are skipped; re-run test asserts no new landing.

risks.mitigation: First intent base not on main => skipped with reason; test it.

risks.mitigation: Anchor at earliest unfulfilled intent base (floored at first intent); test records the behavior.

demonstrations.method: Temp repo with bare origin; main commit whose tree and first parent equal an intent's head_tree_sha and expected_base; no landing; run reconcile with a fake host that counts calls.
demonstrations.observes: One Repaired finding (source Intent); records branch holds a landing with host_commit = that commit and intent = the intent id; host call count 0.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without intent matching the commit goes to the host (count > 0) and no landing is written.

demonstrations.method: Commit with no matching intent; fake host returns Err.
demonstrations.observes: One Unattributed finding mentioning host unavailable; landing file count and records tip unchanged.
demonstrations.fails_without: A swallowed error or a written record would drop the finding or raise the landing count.

demonstrations.method: Commit with no match, plus nearby intents with different tree and different base; host returns Ok(None); variant where host names a PR with no intent.
demonstrations.observes: Unattributed in both cases; no landing written; nearby intents remain unfulfilled.
demonstrations.fails_without: A nearest-intent or nearest-PR guess would write a landing.

demonstrations.method: Intent for PR 7 whose base differs from commit parent; host names PR 7 with same head; a second commit already has a landing.
demonstrations.observes: Landing for PR 7 written (Repaired, source Host); host called once; the already-landed commit skipped with no extra landing.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the fallback the commit stays unattributed and no landing exists.

demonstrations.method: A: unmatched commits before the first intent base and before the last landing, one after; B: no records branch; C: branch with no intent. Also test that an earlier crashed landing with a later landed one is still repaired.
demonstrations.observes: A: only the later commit gets a finding, host never called for older ones. B/C: skipped reason set, no findings, no writes, no host calls.
demonstrations.fails_without: Old commits would be reported or sent to the host.

demonstrations.method: Status: core test calls Athena::status_with_reconcile with a fake Runner on a temp repo with an unattributed commit; a CLI integration test in crates/athena-cli/tests runs the athena status binary (cargo run path) on a temp repo and asserts the Reconcile section; display test renders it. Land: test calls Athena::land_pr with a fake Runner and collecting Ui and asserts the unattributed line is emitted before land fails at a later check (no helper-only test).
